definition.title: Distinguish an action from its outcome
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

steps.title: Distinguish an action from its outcome

blocks.text: An action and its achieved result are different claims. A compatible result can show completion, correctness, successful finding or understanding. In 做好, 好 describes doing something properly or finishing it; in 学会, 会 describes attaining an ability through learning, rather than a standalone quality or skill predicate.

examples.meaning: I looked for the book but did not find it.
I have finished preparing the meal.
